propositions: test_a_missing_epic_field_aborts_provisioning expends the full 120-second production field readiness budget because the stub provides incomplete field data and the readiness poll can only expire
await_required_fields loops with request-check-sleep at 1-second intervals until deadline, causing ~120 stub reads and ~120 real seconds of sleep in the unit test
the production code already honours JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT environment variable and falls back to FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S only when unset, providing a deterministic test seam
setting the readiness budget to zero via environment variable makes the poll loop deterministic: exactly one attempt is made, then monotonic() >= deadline breaks before sleep is called
asserting exactly one /rest/api/2/field read serves as a guard stronger than a timing budget, since a second read only occurs if the loop repeats and calls sleep
